summary.text: Micaelita Debbie O'Malley is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2025, representing District 13 in Bernalillo County.
O'Malley sits on the Senate Conservation Committee and the Senate Tax, Business and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: O'Malley's legislative page lists a district office in Albuquerque.
Between sessions, O'Malley is a member of the Economic and Rural Development and Policy Committee, the New Mexico Finance Authority Oversight Committee and the Water and Natural Resources Committee.
